notes: Pass42.12 development default is startup_debug; use gacha_control.py to switch back to calendar_deterministic.
selection_mode=calendar_deterministic uses the configured IANA timezone and deterministic calendar cycle.
selection_mode=startup_debug selects one process-frozen random-looking automatic set at server startup.
debug_seed=0 or omitted generates and logs a fresh boot seed; a nonzero/string debug_seed reproduces the same startup_debug automatic set.
0 means automatic for that individual manual slot in either mode.
SX weekly slots accept only current SX Girl Hero IDs.
SX daily slots accept only current SX Girl Hero IDs and may not duplicate weekly slots.
Medium manual Hero ID accepts only the 56 featured-only Legacy cohort.
Invalid/ineligible/duplicate manual values warn and fall back rather than crashing.
Runtime validates against data/summon_featured_catalog.json; docs files are operator references only.
